description: EU07 on td.scn on the td/rozklad timetable; at 10:35, as it leaves, the curve tdo_n222 about 950 m ahead buckles hard with a trackbuckle event: 600 mm out of the curve over a main lobe of 8 m (an equivalent radius of 9 m, about 30 m for the body on axles 11 m apart). The AI doesn't see it and runs into it at the 46 km/h it has there: with physics.derailment new (the default, monitor, only logs what the criteria would do and the train runs on) the locomotive leaves the rails on the buckle and stops short of Przystanek.

checks.pattern: Track "tdo_n222" buckled \(event autotest_buckle\): 600 mm to the (left|right) at [0-9.]+ m, main lobe 8.0 m
Bad driving: autotest_\S+ derailed on buckled track
